title: SR-LLM Query Pipeline: reproducibility package for "An Agentic Learning Framework for Systematic Review Literature Search: A Retrospective PubMed Benchmarking Study"
description: Code, data and expected outputs for a two-stage LLM pipeline that generates PubMed Boolean queries for systematic reviews and reduces candidate records by exclusion-criteria filtering and MedCPT re-ranking. Version 2.0 adds the second-revision materials: the harmonized Stage C primary analysis (stageC_harmonized/), preserved historical Run1 Stage 2 records (run1_stage2/), and scripts for the revised figures and supplementary tables. The PubMed API response cache is deposited separately (doi:10.5281/zenodo.20392130).
